description: This PHP source file defines the class ImapTestSettingsEntryHandler, which handles IMAP test settings requests within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for processing requests, saving test settings, and handling exceptions related to IMAP operations.

classes.name: ImapTestSettingsEntryHandler
classes.description: A class that handles IMAP test settings requests, saving test configurations, and managing IMAP-related exceptions within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: handleEntryPointRequest
methods.description: Main method to handle incoming IMAP test settings requests; validates configuration, retrieves request parameters, and returns success or error messages.

methods.name: doSaveTestSettingsKey
methods.description: Attempts to save the test settings key, returning an error message if the operation fails.

methods.name: getSaveTestSettingsKey
methods.description: Uses the ImapHandlerFactory to save the test settings key, returning an error message if saving fails.

methods.name: handleImapHandlerException
methods.description: Handles and logs exceptions thrown by IMAP handlers, translating exception codes into user-friendly error messages.
